blocks.text: Yeh jawless (jabron ke baghair) machhliyan hain. Lampreys aur hagfish aam misaalein hain. In ka jism eel (baam machhli) jaisa hota hai aur us par scales (chhilke) nahi hote. Skeleton cartilage (narm haddi) ka hota hai. Doosri machhliyon ki tarah in ka dil single-circuit hai, jis mein ek atrium aur ek ventricle hota hai. Fertilization jism ke bahar (external) hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Safed par do jabron ke baghair machhliyan saath saath: Sea lamprey, lambi bhoori bam (eel) jaisi machhli jis ki aankh ke peeche gill ke chhote soorakhon ki qataar aur dum ki taraf do neechi dorsal fins hain; Hagfish, narangi-bhoori bam jaisi machhli jo mud kar wapas aati hai aur sar par chhote barbels (moonchh jaise dhaage) hain.
